2. Mr. J.C. Pande, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand/ respondent nos. 1 to 4.
3. Mr. Gaurav Nagpal, learned counsel holding brief 
of Mr. Ramji Srivastava, learned counsel for respondent 
no. 5. 
4. Mr. Hari Mohan Bhatia, learned counsel for 
respondent no. 6.
Delay Condonation Application (IA No. 02/2026)
5. Delay of 40 days in filing the instant Appeal has 
been satisfactorily explained in the affidavit filed in 
support of the Delay Condonation Application. 
Accordingly, the application is allowed. Delay is 
condoned. Office is directed to allot a regular number 
to the instant Appeal. 
Special Appeal No. 69 of 2026
6. The matter requires consideration. 
7. List for hearing after six weeks. 
8. In the meantime, appointment, if any, made in 
pursuance of the impugned advertisement, shall be 
subject to the decision of the instant Appeal.
